versions.content: {DRAFT} If the config parameter EthCtrlConfigSwBufferHandling is set to TRUE, each SW FIFO size shall be configured using a multiple of the parameter EthCtrlConfigEgressFifoBufLe nByte.

If the config parameter EthCtrlConfigSwBufferHandling is set to TRUE, then each SW FIFO shall have the total amount of elements given by EthC- trlConfigEgressFifoBufTotal ( [ECUC_Eth_00050]). Each element shall be of type Eth_BufIdxType.

{OBSOLETE} If the config parameter EthCtrlConfigSwBufferHan- dling is set to TRUE, then each SW FIFO shall have the total amount of elements given by EthCtrlConfigEgressFifoBufTotal ( [ECUC_Eth_00050]). Each element shall be of type Eth_BufIdxType.
